name: dvstack
description: Skills and working files for Playwright testing, front-end work an automated suite can drive, two portable agent habits, and the system around coding agents.

plugins.name: dvstack-frontend
plugins.description: Front-end skills with working source files: markup an automated suite and an AI agent can drive, and a drop-in font switcher.

plugins.name: dvstack-testing
plugins.description: Opinionated Playwright house conventions: suite architecture and naming with copyable templates, step validation and flaky-test fixes, a house-rules review checklist with ESLint config, and Playwright agents/MCP review.

plugins.name: dvstack-agents
plugins.description: Two portable agent habits the base model does not reliably apply: a bounded repo recon before the first edit, and an honest verify loop that reports real output and what was not checked.

plugins.name: dvstack-harness
plugins.description: The system around coding agents: task contracts, tool gates, verify/recover, durable state, hard CI, plus execution-surface mapping, tool design, safeguard parity, boundary tests, risk chains, and token-efficient coding loops.
